name: 2spk_domain_vocab
description: Two-speaker exchange dense with clinical/therapy vocabulary; probes domain-term WER (the one legitimate synthetic training use: vocabulary augmentation).

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: Last session we talked about using cognitive behavioral therapy to interrupt the rumination cycle. How did the thought records go?

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: The thought records helped. I noticed a lot of catastrophizing and some black and white thinking when my anxiety spiked.

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: That's good insight. Those are classic cognitive distortions. Did the diaphragmatic breathing help with the physiological arousal?

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: It did during the panic, but my psychiatrist also adjusted my sertraline dosage, which seemed to reduce the baseline hypervigilance.

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: Good. We can add some dialectical behavior therapy skills, like distress tolerance and emotion regulation, alongside the exposure hierarchy.

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: I'm willing to try the exposure work, though the anticipatory anxiety before each step is still pretty intense.
